answer: Random peer audit keeps the agent economy honest. At dawn each epoch opens, a beacon randomly picks five auditors to re-check new identities, tracing each history like water in karst limestone. Every applicant stakes 50 POA; a fake that fails loses its stake plus a 20 POA fine. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 70 = 7,000 POA, burned before rewards arrive. A willow bends yet stays rooted; honest agents pay one stake only, keeping full rewards.
